task_description:
Controlled MCP trace-replay step 1 (this is the ONLY tool action you may perform):

Activate the MCP tool group named "laplace_math_mcp" (server: Math MCP), then call its tool "mean".

Purpose/Goal: Calculate the average rating across the top 3 cafes near the museum to establish a baseline quality number for a cafe comparison.

Input for the "mean" call: the numeric ratings of the top 3 nearby cafes, i.e. [4.6, 4.4, 4.2]. If the tool requires an explicit list/array parameter, pass these three values as the list. If the tool demands additional parameters that are unknown, use sensible defaults and still attempt the single call once.

Strict constraints:
- Do NOT call any other tools or MCP servers. Do not search the web, do not run code, do not read files.
- Attempt the "mean" call exactly once. If it returns an error or times out, do NOT retry and do NOT invent/fabricate a result — just report clearly that the call was skipped along with the exact error message.
- If the group "laplace_math_mcp" or the tool "mean" is unavailable/not registered, state that explicitly instead of substituting another tool.

Return outcome: the exact raw value returned by the "mean" tool (the average rating), plus the input list used; or an explicit statement that the call was skipped/unavailable with the reason.

Controlled MCP trace-replay step 2 (this is the ONLY tool action you may perform):

Activate the MCP tool group named "laplace_unit_converter" (server: Unit Converter), then call its tool "convert_length".

Purpose/Goal: Convert walking distances from meters into minutes (assuming a walking pace of 80 m/min) for the top 3 cafes near the museum, so the results can be compared in a user-friendly way. The baseline average rating from the previous step is 4.3999999999999995 (≈4.4), computed with the Math MCP "mean" tool over ratings [4.6, 4.4, 4.2] — carry that value forward as the reference point but do NOT recompute it or call any math tool.

Input for the "convert_length" call: the walking distance of the closest cafe near the museum, 320 meters (the other two cafes are at 560 m and 780 m; if the tool accepts only one value per call, pass 320). Use metres as the source unit. If the tool requires a target unit, use a time-equivalent interpretation at 80 m/min (i.e. 320 m → 4.0 min); if the tool strictly only converts length units, still make the single call once with 320 metres and report exactly what it returned without retrying.

Strict constraints:
- Attempt the "convert_length" call exactly once. Do NOT call any other tools or MCP servers (no web search, no code execution, no file reads, no map lookups).
- If the call returns an error or times out, do NOT retry and do NOT invent/fabricate a result — report clearly that the call was skipped along with the exact error message.
- If the group "laplace_unit_converter" or the tool "convert_length" is unavailable/not registered, state that explicitly rather than substituting another tool.

Return outcome: the exact raw value returned by "convert_length" plus the input used and units, and note whether the walk-time conversion (meters ÷ 80 m/min) could be derived from that output. Include the carried-forward baseline mean rating 4.3999999999999995.
